Well then, you and your wife are doing great.

These guests came from Korea after all.
Why would they bring beef with them?
Here, let me test this piece.

examples.text: Подожди, это наш гость из Кореи.
examples.trans: Wait, this is our guest from Korea.

examples.text: И готовим только из собственных продуктов.
examples.trans: And we cook only from our own ingredients.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'why', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Зачем им везти с собой говядину?
examples.trans: Why would they bring beef with them?

examples.text: Настя, скажи, зачем ты меня звала?
examples.trans: Nastya, tell me, why did you call me?

examples.text: Костя, скажи, зачем ты нас звал?
examples.trans: Kostya, tell me, why did you call us?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'them', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я всё понимаю, но гость заплатит.
examples.trans: I understand everything, but the guest will pay.

examples.text: Шеф, может быть, мы это похороним?
examples.trans: Chef, maybe we should bury this?

examples.text: А может быть, вас всех похоронить?
examples.trans: Or maybe I should bury all of you?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to transport, drive, carry', paired with 'повезти'.

examples.text: Зачем им везти с собой говядину?
examples.trans: Why would they bring beef with them?

examples.text: Нам ещё повезло, если это телятина.
examples.trans: We are lucky if this is veal.

examples.text: Тимур, немедленно вези его обратно в отель!
examples.trans: Timur, take him back to the hotel immediately!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'oneself', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мне надо спокойно разобраться в себе.
examples.trans: I need to calmly figure myself out.

examples.text: Может, Костя выбирает себе лучшего друга.
examples.trans: Maybe Kostya is choosing a best friend for himself.

examples.text: Я чувствую себя хорошо.
examples.trans: I feel good.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'beef' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Вы не могли бы приготовить говядину?
examples.trans: Could you please cook this beef?

examples.text: Зачем им везти с собой говядину?
examples.trans: Why would they bring beef with them?

examples.text: Я точно вижу, что это говядина.
examples.trans: I see for sure that this is beef.

meanings.en: come on, go on, let's see
meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'well now, come on', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ну-ка, дай мне проверить этот кусок.
examples.trans: Here, let me test this piece.

examples.text: Ну-ка скажи!
examples.trans: Go on, tell me!

examples.text: Ну-ка, покажи.
examples.trans: Come on, show me.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'give', paired with 'давать'.

examples.text: Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: Give me just one.

examples.text: Дайте, пожалуйста, воды.
examples.trans: Some water, please.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify
meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'верить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to check, to test', paired with 'проверять'.

examples.text: Ну-ка, дай мне проверить этот кусок.
examples.trans: Here, let me test this piece.

examples.text: Паяльник проверь.
examples.trans: Check the soldering iron.

examples.text: Сейчас всё проверим.
examples.trans: We'll check everything right now.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronominal determiner meaning 'this', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Интересно, это японцы или китайцы?
examples.trans: I wonder, are they Japanese or Chinese?

examples.text: Подожди, это наш гость из Кореи.
examples.trans: Wait, this is our guest from Korea.

examples.text: Это же гости приехали из Кореи.
examples.trans: These guests came from Korea after all.
